verdict.rationale: Discord is a voice and chat communication platform, so AI-generated notes and recaps of calls are a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any first-party AI transcription, notes, or recap feature for voice calls. Developer primitives such as bots, the Gateway, and the Social SDK voice chat are building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated notes and recaps from meetings and huddles I attended or missed
